Portfolio net worth is around M$604 with spendable balance near the M$10 operational floor, held down by resolution latency on the Aug 11-14 resolution cluster (reaching a 6-day baseline delay) which continues to lock capital and create opportunity costs. Active positions have been trimmed to 10. The portfolio is anchored by core Timeline NO frameworks, high-conviction personal YES bets (such as the 5-year partner milestone), and site-outage or event bets. Two notable positions were recently closed: KBTU (wsp.kbtu.kz site outage on registration day) was sold for a M$-5 loss after the site remained operational during the event window, and Starship Ship 40 recovery NO was sold for a M$-18 loss after marine reports confirmed the recovery tow was complete, invalidating the "likely lost at sea" thesis. 

Standing priorities remain unchanged: immediately settle the M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 as soon as the Aug 11-14 resolution cluster clears, re-evaluate Jared Moskowitz's Florida primary for entry, and execute a fresh market scan rather than blindly acting on stale watchlist items (such as Anglo American/Teck or US-Iran peace talks, where edges have compressed). 

Mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for multi-day resolution latency, falling into the stale execution trap by blindly deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress, holding onto positions after their core thesis has been directly contradicted by new information (as seen with Starship and KBTU), and dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets. Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic end-of-month and anniversary hype where developers release teasers rather than deliverables, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets require strict carve-outs from core strategic rules. Specific still-open markets requiring attention include the WTI Aug 20 position, which is approaching its deadline and requires active price monitoring before close.
